A correct explanation in terms of charge and a correct explanation in terms of energy Explanations in terms of charge: • (particles / decay) positively charged so cannot be $\beta^{-}$ • (particles / decay) positively charged so could be / is $\beta^{+}$ • $\beta^{-}$ (particles / decay) are negatively charged • $\beta^{+}$ (particles / decay) are positively charged Explanations in terms of energy: • range of energies so not $\alpha$ (particles / decay) • range of energies so is $\beta$ (particles / decay) • $\beta$ (particles / decay) have a range of energies • $\alpha$ (particles / decay) have discrete energies / not range of energies
